question.prompt: Segment \(AB=6\) cm. Point \(P\) lies on the perpendicular bisector of \(AB\), and \(PA=5\) cm. Find the distance from \(P\) to line \(AB\). (Unit: cm)

solutions.explanation: Let the foot of the perpendicular be \(M\). Then \(AM=3\), \(PM\perp AB\), and \(PM=\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4\).
solutions.title: Use the perpendicular distance
